title: Slovakian Confit Duck Leg with German Spaetzle
description: A traditional German dish with a twist from Slovakia, featuring tender confit duck leg served with homemade spaetzle and a side of braised red cabbage.
instructions: Season the duck legs with salt and black pepper.
Bake the duck legs for 20 minutes.
While the duck is baking, cook the spaetzle according to the package instructions.
In a large pan, sauté the chopped onion and caraway seeds until softened.
Add the braised red cabbage to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the confit duck leg with the spaetzle and braised red cabbage.
Drizzle with apple cider vinegar and serve immediately.
